@graph.name: US Nuclear Power Plants
@graph.description: Operable electric generating plants in the US by energy source (nuclear) from the United States Energy Administration.

additionalProperty.name: process_step
additionalProperty.value:
#########
  # GDSC ETL is performed in two steps: shell script to ETL data into postgres
  # and then additional transformations with SQL in postGIS (if needed).
  ####
  
  #########
  # Step 1 - bash script (pseudo code)
  ####
  
  # create directory structure and move into it
  mkdir -p /data/us_nuclear_power_plants/download -p /data/us_nuclear_power_plants/etl
  chmod -R 777 /data/us_nuclear_power_plants
  cd /data/us_nuclear_power_plants
  
  # set update flag based on last update and update frequency
  do_update=0 if date() < last_update + update_frequency else do_update = 1
  
  # download if update flag is set:
  if do_update == 1 then
  wget --retry-connrefused --waitretry=1 --read-timeout=20 --timeout=15 -t 10 -O download/us_nuclear_power_plants.json 'https://services7.arcgis.com/FGr1D95XCGALKXqM/arcgis/rest/services/ElectricPowerPlants/FeatureServer/6/query?where=1%3D1&outFields=*&outSR=4326&f=json' 2>&1
  
  # load into postGIS with:
  ogr2ogr -lco GEOMETRY_NAME=geom -f PostgreSQL PG:"<postgres connection>" download/us_nuclear_power_plants.json -nlt point -nln us_nuclear_power_plants
  echo success: us_nuclear_power_plants.json loaded with ogr2ogr
  
  
  #########
  # Step 2 - SQL script (pseudo code):
  ####
  
  # remove duplicate points and make geometries valid:
  UPDATE us_nuclear_power_plants
    SET geom=ST_MakeValid(ST_RemoveRepeatedPoints(geom));
  
  # add local geometry column and reproject existing geometries into local EPSG:
  ALTER TABLE us_nuclear_power_plants DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS geom_local CASCADE;
  SELECT AddGeometryColumn (
    'us_nuclear_power_plants',
    'geom_local', 2236, 'point', 2
  );
  UPDATE us_nuclear_power_plants
    SET geom_local=ST_MakeValid(ST_RemoveRepeatedPoints(ST_Transform(geom,2236)));
  CREATE INDEX us_nuclear_power_plants_geom_local_idx
    ON us_nuclear_power_plants
    USING GIST (geom_local);
  NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';
